## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and the behavior before and after this change.
Link an issue if one exists.

## Validation

List the relevant commands and results. For a selection fix, include a small
counterexample and the independently expected record/value. For report changes,
include semantic verification and any intentional saved-artifact differences.

## Contract changes

Explain any changes to availability, revision, freshness, timezone or missingness
rules. State whether examples and English/Chinese documentation need updating.
